entities.name: UniProt P80323 Curvaticin FS47
observations: Reviewed Latilactobacillus curvatus bacteriocin; the submitted 38-aa sequence is an exact, full-length sequence match (100% identity and coverage; E-value 8.6e-17). UniProt annotation reports activity against Listeria monocytogenes, Pediococcus, Enterococcus, Lactobacilli, and Bacilli.
